# vLLM

> vLLM is a high-throughput, memory-efficient inference and serving engine for large language models. These docs cover installation, the OpenAI-compatible server, distributed serving, quantization and other features, supported models, configuration, and the CLI.

## Getting started

- [Quickstart](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/getting_started/quickstart/): Install vLLM, run offline batched inference, and start the OpenAI-compatible server
- [Installation](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/getting_started/installation/): Hardware-specific install guides (GPU, CPU, and other accelerators)

## Serving

- [Online serving](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/serving/online_serving/): Serve models over HTTP with the OpenAI-compatible API
- [Offline inference](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/serving/offline_inference/): Run inference on batches of prompts with the LLM class
- [Parallelism and scaling](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/serving/parallelism_scaling/): Tensor, pipeline, data, and expert parallelism across GPUs and nodes
- [Data-parallel deployment](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/serving/data_parallel_deployment/): Run multiple model replicas behind one endpoint
- [Expert-parallel deployment](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/serving/expert_parallel_deployment/): Scale mixture-of-experts models across devices
- [Context-parallel deployment](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/serving/context_parallel_deployment/): Split long-context inference across devices
- [Distributed troubleshooting](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/serving/distributed_troubleshooting/): Debug multi-GPU and multi-node serving issues

## Deployment

- [Docker](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/deployment/docker/): Run vLLM with the official container images
- [Kubernetes](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/deployment/k8s/): Deploy vLLM on Kubernetes
- [Nginx](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/deployment/nginx/): Load-balance multiple vLLM servers behind Nginx

## Configuration

- [Configuration overview](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/configuration/): How model, engine, and server options fit together
- [Engine arguments](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/configuration/engine_args/): Every engine option, with defaults
- [Server arguments](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/configuration/serve_args/): Options for `vllm serve`
- [Environment variables](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/configuration/env_vars/): Runtime environment configuration
- [Model resolution](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/configuration/model_resolution/): How vLLM resolves model names and architectures
- [Optimization and tuning](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/configuration/optimization/): Throughput and latency tuning
- [Conserving memory](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/configuration/conserving_memory/): Fit larger models on limited hardware

## Features

- [Quantization](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/features/quantization/): Supported quantization schemes and hardware support
- [LoRA adapters](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/features/lora/): Serve LoRA adapters, including dynamic loading
- [Tool calling](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/features/tool_calling/): OpenAI-compatible function and tool calling
- [Structured outputs](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/features/structured_outputs/): Constrain generation with JSON schemas and grammars
- [Reasoning outputs](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/features/reasoning_outputs/): Expose reasoning content from reasoning models
- [Speculative decoding](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/features/speculative_decoding/): Speed up decoding with draft models and n-gram lookahead
- [Multimodal inputs](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/features/multimodal_inputs/): Pass images, audio, and video to multimodal models
- [Automatic prefix caching](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/features/automatic_prefix_caching/): Reuse KV cache across prompts with shared prefixes
- [Context extension](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/features/context_extension/): Extend model context windows
- [Sleep mode](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/features/sleep_mode/): Free GPU memory between workloads without restarting
- [Prompt embeddings](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/features/prompt_embeds/): Pass precomputed prompt embeddings

## Models

- [Supported models](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/models/supported_models/): The list of supported model architectures
- [Generative models](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/models/generative_models/): How vLLM runs text-generation models
- [Pooling models](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/models/pooling_models/): Embedding, reward, and classification models

## CLI

- [CLI overview](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/cli/): The `vllm` command-line interface
- [vllm serve](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/cli/serve/): Start the OpenAI-compatible server
- [vllm chat](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/cli/chat/): Chat with a running vLLM server from the terminal
- [vllm complete](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/cli/complete/): Text completions against a running server
- [vllm run-batch](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/cli/run-batch/): Run OpenAI-style batch files offline
- [vllm bench](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/cli/bench/): Benchmark latency, throughput, and serving performance

## Usage

- [FAQ](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/usage/faq/): Frequently asked questions
- [Metrics](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/usage/metrics/): Prometheus metrics exposed by the server
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/usage/troubleshooting/): Common failures and how to debug them
- [Security](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/usage/security/): Security model and deployment guidance
- [V1 engine guide](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/usage/v1_guide/): The V1 engine architecture and differences
- [Reproducibility](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/usage/reproducibility/): What determinism vLLM does and does not guarantee
- [Usage stats](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/usage/usage_stats/): What anonymous usage data is collected and how to opt out

## API

- [API reference](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/api/): Python API reference for vLLM internals

## Optional

- [Benchmarking](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/benchmarking/): Benchmark suites and dashboards
